name: Waxahachie Towne Center
summary: Waxahachie Towne Center is a community shopping center anchored by Belk department store, serving the Waxahachie area along North Highway 77. This open-air retail destination offers convenient access to national retailers and local services for families and residents in Ellis County.
demographics: Waxahachie Towne Center serves a growing suburban and exurban market in Ellis County, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from Waxahachie and surrounding communities. The trade area consists primarily of households with median incomes in the $50,000-$75,000 range, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees drawn to the area's affordable housing and small-town atmosphere. Shoppers typically seek convenient access to everyday necessities, value-oriented retailers, and family-friendly dining options, reflecting the practical shopping preferences of this Texas community located approximately 30 miles south of Dallas.
description: Waxahachie Towne Center is a community shopping destination serving the historic city of Waxahachie and the broader Ellis County area in North Texas. Strategically located along North Highway 77, this open-air retail center provides convenient access to shopping, dining, and services for the growing suburban communities south of the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. The center is anchored by Belk department store and features a practical mix of national retailers and local businesses catering to everyday family needs. With its accessible location and ample parking, Waxahachie Towne Center has become a reliable shopping hub for residents seeking quality merchandise and services without the drive into the larger metropolitan area. The center maintains a welcoming, small-town atmosphere while offering the convenience and selection that modern shoppers expect, making it an integral part of the Waxahachie community's retail landscape.
